{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    localparam LEVELS = (WIDTH > 1) ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 0;

    wire [WIDTH-1:0] x;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ag [0:LEVELS];
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ap [0:LEVELS];
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bg [0:LEVELS];
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bp [0:LEVELS];
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ab_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ba_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] selected;

    wire sel_add = (Oper == 3'b000);
    wire sel_ab  = (Oper == 3'b001);
    wire sel_ba  = (Oper == 3'b010);
    wire sel_or  = (Oper == 3'b011);
    wire sel_and = (Oper == 3'b100);
    wire sel_xor = (Oper == 3'b101);
    wire sel_xnr = (Oper == 3'b110);

    assign x = a ^ b;
    assign ag[0] = a & b;
    assign ap[0] = x;
    assign bg[0] = (~a) & b;
    assign bp[0] = ~x;

    genvar s, i;
    generate
        for (s = 0; s < LEVELS; s = s + 1) begin : prefix_stage
            for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : prefix_bit
                if (i >= (1 << s)) begin : combine
                    assign ag[s+1][i] = ag[s][i] |
                        (ap[s][i] & ag[s][i-(1 << s)]);
                    assign ap[s+1][i] = ap[s][i] & ap[s][i-(1 << s)];
                    assign bg[s+1][i] = bg[s][i] |
                        (bp[s][i] & bg[s][i-(1 << s)]);
                    assign bp[s+1][i] = bp[s][i] & bp[s][i-(1 << s)];
                end else begin : pass_through
                    assign ag[s+1][i] = ag[s][i];
                    assign ap[s+1][i] = ap[s][i];
                    assign bg[s+1][i] = bg[s][i];
                    assign bp[s+1][i] = bp[s][i];
                end
            end
        end
        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : result_bit
            if (i == 0) begin : low_bit
                assign add_result[i] = x[i];
                assign ab_result[i] = x[i];
                assign ba_result[i] = x[i];
            end else begin : upper_bit
                assign add_result[i] = x[i] ^ ag[LEVELS][i-1];
                assign ab_result[i] = x[i] ^ bg[LEVELS][i-1];
                assign ba_result[i] = x[i] ^
                    (~(bg[LEVELS][i-1] | bp[LEVELS][i-1]));
            end
            assign selected[i] =
                (sel_add & add_result[i]) |
                (sel_ab  & ab_result[i]) |
                (sel_ba  & ba_result[i]) |
                (sel_or  & (a[i] | b[i])) |
                (sel_and & (a[i] & b[i])) |
                (sel_xor & x[i]) |
                (sel_xnr & ~x[i]);
        end
    endgenerate

    always @* begin
        sum = selected;
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The likely critical path is arithmetic carry or borrow propagation followed by operation selection. Independently inferred arithmetic operators can also duplicate subtraction hardware without explicitly sharing comparison information.",
  "rewrite": "Use parallel logarithmic prefix networks for addition carries and a-minus-b borrows. The subtraction network also computes lower-slice equality. For each nonempty lower slice, the reverse-subtraction borrow is the complement of the OR of the forward borrow and equality, allowing both subtraction results to share one prefix network. Select the seven results with decoded, parallel masked terms.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "At WIDTH=16, each prefix network has four combining stages rather than a potentially linear carry chain. Operation decoding runs in parallel with arithmetic. This targets lower maximum data arrival, but the actual gain requires the specified SKY130HD mapping and STA; no measured timing improvement is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Prefix wiring and parallel result selection trade area and routing capacitance for carry depth. Sharing the two subtraction directions reduces duplication. Unused prefix nodes can be removed during synthesis. Compliance with the 3074.698880um2 cap and electrical constraints requires evaluation; it has not been measured here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, ports, unsigned vector types, WIDTH parameter and default WIDTH=64. For every binary input at WIDTH=16, operations 000 through 110 implement the original seven operations with WIDTH-bit truncation, and 111 returns zero. The implementation is purely combinational with no state, added latency, assumptions, or helper-module dependencies."
}
